Flood.description: Inundation of agricultural land due to excess water.

Flash Flood.description: Rapid inundation of haor basin crops within 6-12 hours.
mitigation: Evacuate cattle to high-ground Machrang shelters

Tropical Cyclone.description: Severe wind and tidal surge impacting coastal polders.
mitigation: Close all polder sluice gates immediately
Apply gypsum to flush salt from soils post-surge

Drought.description: Prolonged moisture stress in Barind Tract and Rabi season.
mitigation: Apply straw mulch to reduce evaporation
Shift to short-duration pulses if Boro fails

Heat Wave.description: Extreme temperatures >35°C causing broiler mortality & spike sterility.
mitigation: Provide electrolytes (Vit C) in poultry drinking water
Maintain 5-7cm standing water in rice fields to buffer soil temp
Install foggers/roof sprinklers on poultry sheds

Cold Wave.description: Sub-10°C temperature drop affecting Boro seedbeds and livestock.
mitigation: Cover seedbeds with polythene sheets at night
Irrigate seedbeds with warm groundwater in early morning
Vaccinate livestock against FMD and respiratory infections
